notes.text: Siddhartha Gautama, most commonly referred to as the Buddha, was a wandering ascetic and religious teacher who lived in the eastern Indo-Gangetic Plains during the 6th or 5th century BCE and founded Buddhism.
The Buddha then wandered through the lower Indo-Gangetic Plain, teaching and building a monastic order (sangha).
Buddha is remembered as a philosopher connected with Ancient India.
Buddha's recorded life dates place this profile around 563-483 BCE.
Buddha is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
